title: Local Staging SQL cache authority seed recovery

phases.objective: Restore the repository-owned sql_cache_policy_v2 authority row in Local Windows/Docker Staging through exact-checksum-bound Staging recovery surfaces while keeping the runtime application principal SELECT-only on sql_cache_runtime_policies and preserving fail-closed environment isolation.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Docker Staging recovery operator
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Local Staging has exactly one canonical sql_cache_policy_v2 row, the runtime principal can read it through least-privilege SELECT authority, MySQL remains the policy authority, and Staging certification is eligible to proceed without Production or provider mutation.
steps: Bind the recovery to the exact local Staging commit and repository-owned migration checksum.
Require the sql_cache_runtime_policies base table to exist before non-destructive readiness reconciliation.
If sql_cache_policy_v2 is absent, apply only the idempotent authority-seed INSERT from 1023_sprint69_sql_cache_runtime_policy.sql using the local Runtime DB root identity.
Read back exactly one policy row with revision at least one, required=false, and endpoints retained in the immutable table blocklist.
Reconcile repository-owned Staging grants so runtime_app retains SELECT-only authority on sql_cache_runtime_policies and receives no policy write authority.
Restart and require the normal Staging certification lifecycle on the exact commit.
assertions: The authority seed is Local Staging only and exact-checksum bound.
The shared Production runtime-bootstrap contract is unchanged.
runtime_app receives SELECT only on sql_cache_runtime_policies and no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, schema-wide privilege, global privilege, GRANT OPTION, or delegated role.
The seed readback requires one sql_cache_policy_v2 row, revision >= 1, required=false, and endpoints in table_blocklist.
The canonical seed value for enabled is preserved rather than overridden by the recovery path.
No database reset, schema replay, data-directory move, Production access, Hostinger/Cloudflare mutation, provider mutation, or Production credential access is authorized.

phases.objective: Production and provider execution remain outside this Staging-only authority-seed recovery.
blockers: Production requires a separate governed promotion lifecycle.
No Production database, Hostinger, Cloudflare, provider, ruleset, credential, or deployment mutation is authorized by this declaration.
